description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

description:
Fish Maw is sun-dried swim bladder of fish which is commonly used in Chinese cooking and in Chinese soups. Fish Maw is an excellent source of collagen.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

RECIPE

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup
Ingredients: 3 sea cucumbers, 80g fish maw, 300g pork shin
1. Rinse all the ingredients thoroughly and blanch pork shin.
2. Combine all ingredients with 2500ml of water in a pot. Place over high heat until the water boils and then switch to low heat to simmer for additional 2 hours. Add salt to taste.

Storage Condition

You are strongly recommended to store the items in a clean, ventilating and dry place.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

Fish Maw is sun-dried swim bladder of fish which is an internal gas-filled organ found in most fish. It is commonly used in Chinese cooking and in Chinese soups. Fish Maw is an excellent source of collagen.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup

description: Biltong is the South African version of Beef Jerky. Imagine if jerky and prosciutto had a baby. That baby would be biltong. Ever since I was a little "laaitjie" in Pretoria, South Africa, playing around my grandfather's butchery I realized the potential of biltong. Oupa Dawie was a very disciplined, lovable butcher and respected hunter that made some of the "best biltong" in Pretoria. We would never leave without brown bags stuffed full of delicious dried meat for the ride home. In Africa, biltong is a household name, but I always felt that it was a taste that needs to be shared with the rest of the world.Many years later I found myself living as a programmer and part time musician in Brooklyn, NY. After I met and married Emily we started our journey together in an inspiring city. We both had hearts for South Africa and its people, culture and traditions. It became clear that presenting a product from there would be an excellent way to connect our love for our current neighborhood as well as SA. We made our first batch of biltong in 2012 as a snack for our wedding reception. None of our friends had tasted it before, but they met it with delighted tastebuds, and a demand for more! Their excitement in discovering Biltong led us to recognize the opportunity we had to make it more widely known. The company was built with two goals in mind: Introduce Biltong to America, and make a difference in our neighborhood while doing so. Businesses are in ideal positions to make widespread difference to the betterment of society, because their good deeds comes from their business passion. Biltong donation through City Harvest We established what we call 'Eat and Feed.' title: Nema Sliced Pastirma 6 oz.
description: Pastirma as well as basterma, is a highly seasoned, air-dried cured beef that is part of the cuisines of a number of countries. Pastırma can be eaten as a breakfast dish and it is a commonly ingredient for omelettes, menemen or a variation of eggs benedict. Pastırma can be used as a topping for pide bread, hamburgers, and hummus. It may be combined with potato to make a filling for traditional bureks as well. It is also a common addition to many of the traditional vegetable dishes, especially the tomato and fava bean stew called kuru fasulye, but also cabbage (pastırmalı lahana), chickpeas (pastırmalı nohut), asparagus (pastırmalı kuşkonmaz) and spinach (pastırmalı ıspanak).[ It can also be used to make cheesy pull-apart bread.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

description:
Biltong, Droewors and Boerewors are the things that South Africans dream of in the USA and All American Biltong is the best in the United States. All of our Biltong, Droewors and Boerewors products are USDA approved and are also made in the traditional South African way.

What is Biltong and Droëwors? Biltong is the name for a traditional form of South African preserved meat. The name originates from the Dutch word BIL meaning buttock and TONG meaning strip. Biltong has it's earliest origins in Medieval Europe and was thought to be introduced to South Africa by the arrival of Dutch Settlers at the Cape of Good Hope in 1652. Biltong has no comparison as a meat snack and is certainly not "beef jerky". Biltong is a gourmet delicacy that South Africans love to eat and it is made by salting, spicing and air dry curing selected cuts of Beef, Venison or Ostrich. Droëwors is a air dried sausage made from a mixture of Beef and Lamb and natural spices and herbs and is extremely popular in South Africa, Karoo Droëwors must contain lamb as without lamb there is very little flavor and it becomes just another meat stick

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

description: Kalahari Biltong was started after the adventure of a lifetime - where three best friends traveled to South Africa to race a total of 175 miles in an Ironman and Ultra Marathon, all within 6 days Upon arrival, our South African teammate introduced us to his homelands unofficial national treasure, Biltong. What is it? Probably the most delicious meat snack weÕve ever had in our lives. After literally eating close to our body weight in Biltong we were hooked. Imagine the tenderness and texture of prosciutto, the lean protein of jerky, and the beef flavor of steak tartare. Being in awe of the depth of flavor, we were stunned when we learned of the sheer simplicity of the ingredients and inherently natural process of crafting Biltong. From that point on we knew there was no going back to endless gnawing on dry, damaged-by-high-heat, and pumped-full-of-artificial- ingredient jerky, that we have been suffering from in the USA. This had to change. Immediately upon arriving home, we swore we had to find a way to liberate the American taste bud and general health from the oppression of all jerky. We called BS on Jerky. Our mission? To use a centuries-old South African tradition of simply seasoning and air drying beef to change the way people think of jerky.We knew the only way to succeed was in never cutting corners, always using the highest quality, single origin beef, and provide complete transparency for all 6 of our ingredients. And Kalahari Biltong was born.

From our Ranch in Montana to your home!]
description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

bullet_point: [Contains one (1) 16 oz. resealable package of turkey sausage snack sticks, Turkey sausage snack sticks are a delicious ready-to-eat paleo alternative to turkey jerky and other dried meat snacks, We handcraft our sausage snacks with only the most premium cuts of meat, with no binders, fillers, or extenders, Our turkey snack sticks have all of the great flavor and even more protein than our regular varieties, with fewer calories and less fat, These appetizing snack sticks contain no MSG and are the ultimate blend of convenience and flavor, perfect for men, women, and kids on-the-go looking to give their taste buds a healthy treat]
description:
At Old Wisconsin, we craft the finest sausages because we pick only the most premium cuts of beef, pork and turkey. Next we use the perfect recipe of spices passed down by generations of sausage makers. These spices complement our meats, ensuring that they enhance the natural flavors while never overpowering them. We use no binders, fillers or extenders—just enormous care to ensure that our sausages are always mouthwateringly delicious. We hand craft our meats into a variety of shapes and sizes before we begin the smoking process. We smoke all of our meats slowly over real hardwood fires in our traditional pit style smokehouse to ensure natural flavor. We leave them hanging for as long as it takes until we're satisfied with the flavor. After we smoke our meats, we pack them immediately to seal in the freshness and flavor. Quality control procedures are in place at every step of the process, and goods are stored under optimal temperatures to maintain freshness and quality. But our products rarely sit around. We ship to retailers all across the country, allowing everyone to experience the true taste of Wisconsin.

En Old Wisconsin, elaboramos las mejores salchichas porque elegimos solo los cortes de carne de res, cerdo y pavo. A continuación usamos la receta perfecta de especias transmitidas por generaciones de fabricantes de salchichas. Estas especias complementan nuestras carnes, asegurando que mejoren los sabores naturales sin embargo nunca las abruman. No utilizamos aglutinantes, rellenos o extensores – solo un enorme cuidado para asegurar que nuestras salchichas siempre sean deliciosas deliciosas. Elaboramos nuestras carnes a mano en una variedad de formas y tamaños antes de comenzar el proceso de fumar. Fumamos todas nuestras carnes lentamente sobre fuegos de madera dura real en nuestro ahumadero tradicional estilo hoyo para garantizar sabor natural. Los dejamos colgados durante el tiempo que se tarda hasta que estemos satisfechos con el sabor. Después de fumar nuestras carnes, las empacamos inmediatamente para sellar la frescura y el sabor. Los procedimientos de control de calidad están en vigor en cada paso del proceso, y los productos se almacenan a temperaturas óptimas para mantener la frescura y la calidad. Pero nuestros productos rara vez se sientan alrededor. Enviamos a minoristas de todo el país, permitiendo que todos experimenten el verdadero sabor de Wisconsin.

ב-Old Wisconsin, אנו מייצרים את הנקניקיות הטובות ביותר כי אנו בוחרים רק את החתיכות הפרימיום ביותר של בשר בקר, חזיר והודו. לאחר מכן אנו משתמשים במתכון המושלם של תבלינים שעברו דורות של יצרני נקניקיות. תבלינים אלה משלימים את הבשרים שלנו, ומבטיחים שהם מגבירים את הטעמים הטבעיים תוך כדי שהם לעולם לא יעלו עליהם. אנחנו לא משתמשים בקלסרים, חומרי מילוי או מאריכים - רק טיפול עצום כדי להבטיח כי הנקניקיות שלנו תמיד טעימות להפליא. אנו מייצרים את הבשרים שלנו ידנית למגוון צורות וגדלים לפני תחילת תהליך העישון. אנחנו מעשנים את כל הבשרים שלנו לאט על שריפות עץ אמיתי בבית העישון המסורתי שלנו כדי להבטיח טעם טבעי. אנחנו משאירים אותם תלויים כל עוד זה לוקח עד שאנחנו מרוצים מהטעם. אחרי שאנחנו מעשנים את הבשרים שלנו, אנחנו אורזים אותם מיד כדי לאטום את הרעננות והטעם. תהליכי בקרת איכות ממוקמים בכל שלב של התהליך, והמוצרים מאוחסנים בטמפרטורות אופטימליות כדי לשמור על טריות ואיכות. אבל המוצרים שלנו לעתים נדירות יושבים. אנחנו שולחים לקמעונאים בכל רחבי הארץ, ומאפשרים לכולם לחוות את הטעם האמיתי של ויסקונסין.

Bei Old Wisconsin fertigen wir die feinsten Würstchen an, weil wir nur die hochwertigsten Stücke von Rind, Schweinefleisch und Truthahn wählen. Als nächstes verwenden wir das perfekte Rezept von Gewürzen, die von Generationen von Wurstherstellern weitergegeben wurden. Diese Gewürze ergänzen unser Fleisch, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die natürlichen Aromen verbessern und sie niemals überwältigen. Wir verwenden keine Bindemittel, Füllstoffe oder Extender – nur enorme Sorgfalt, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Würstchen immer köstlich sind. Wir fertigen unser Fleisch in eine Vielzahl von Formen und Größen, bevor wir mit dem Räuchern beginnen. Wir räuchern alle unsere Fleischsorten langsam über echtem Hartholzfeuer in unserem traditionellen Räucherofen im Gruben-Stil, um einen natürlichen Geschmack zu gewährleisten. Wir lassen sie so lange hängen, wie es dauert, bis wir mit dem Geschmack zufrieden sind. Nachdem wir unser Fleisch geraucht haben, verpacken wir sie sofort, um die Frische und den Geschmack einzuschließen. Qualitätskontrollverfahren werden bei jedem Schritt des Prozesses eingesetzt, und die Waren werden unter optimalen Temperaturen gelagert, um Frische und Qualität zu erhalten. Aber unsere Produkte sitzen selten herum. Wir versenden Einzelhändler im ganzen Land, so dass jeder den wahren Geschmack von Wisconsin erleben kann.

في أولد ويسكونسن، نصنع أجود النقانق لأننا نختار فقط القطع الأكثر تميزًا من اللحم البقري والخنزير والديك الرومي. بعد ذلك نستخدم الوصفة المثالية للتوابل التي تتوارثها أجيال من صانعي السجق. هذه التوابل تكمّل لحومنا، مما يضمن أنها تعزز النكهات الطبيعية مع عدم الإفراط في استخدامها. نحن لا نستخدم مواد لاصقة أو مواد مالئة أو موسِّعات - فقط عناية كبيرة لضمان أن نقاققنا لذيذة بشكل دائم. نصنع لحومنا يدويًا في مجموعة متنوعة من الأشكال والأحجام قبل أن نبدأ عملية التدخين. نقوم بتدخين جميع لحومنا ببطء على حرائق الخشب الصلب الحقيقي في بيت الدخان التقليدي الخاص بنا لضمان النكهة الطبيعية. نتركها معلقتين طالما أن الأمر يستغرق حتى نحظى بالرضا عن النكهة. بعد تدخيننا لحوم، نعبئتها على الفور للحفاظ على النضارة والنكهة. توجد إجراءات مراقبة الجودة في كل خطوة من العملية، ويتم تخزين البضائع تحت درجات حرارة مثالية للحفاظ على النضارة والجودة. ولكن منتجاتنا نادرًا ما تتواجد حولها. نشحن إلى تجار التجزئة في جميع أنحاء البلاد، مما يسمح للجميع بتجربة الطعم الحقيقي لوسكونسن.

Na Old Wisconsin, fabricamos as melhores linguiças porque escolhemos apenas os cortes de carne bovina, porco e peru. Em seguida, usamos a receita perfeita de especiarias passadas por gerações de fabricantes de linguiças. Estas especiarias complementam nossas carnes, garantindo que elas realçam os sabores naturais enquanto nunca os dominam. Não usamos pastas, enchimentos ou extensores — apenas um cuidado enorme para garantir que nossas linguiças estejam sempre deliciosas. Fabricamos nossas carnes à mão em uma variedade de formas e tamanhos antes de começarmos o processo de fumar. Fumamos todas as nossas carnes lentamente sobre incêndios de madeira reais em nossa casa de fumê tradicional para garantir o sabor natural. Deixamos eles pendurados o tempo que for necessário até estarmos satisfeitos com o sabor. Depois que fumamos nossas carnes, as embalamos imediatamente para selar o frescor e o sabor. Procedimentos de controle de qualidade estão em vigor em cada etapa do processo, e os produtos são armazenados sob temperaturas ideais para manter o frescor e a qualidade. Mas nossos produtos raramente ficam por aí. Enviamos para varejistas em todo o país, permitindo que todos experimentem o verdadeiro gosto de Wisconsin.

在 Old Wisconsin,我們製作最好的香腸,因為我們只挑選最優質的牛肉、豬肉和火雞。 接下來,我們使用一代香腸製造商傳承的完美香料配方。 ​ 這些香料與我們的肉相得益彰,確保它們增強天然風味,同時不會過度刺激它們。 我們不使用粘合劑、填充物或延長劑 - 只需非常小心,以確保我們的香腸總是美味。 在開始吸煙過程之前,我們會手工製作各種形狀和尺寸的肉類。 ​ 我們用傳統鍋式煙燻屋慢慢地在真正的硬木火上抽取所有肉類,以確保天然風味。 只要花一段時間,我們就會把它們掛起來,直到我們滿意味道。 在抽取肉後,我們會立即包裝,以密封新鮮和風味。 ​ 流程的每一步都有品質控制程序,並儲存在最佳溫度下,以保持新鮮度和品質。 但我們的產品很少會坐在身邊。 我們運送到全國各地的零售商,讓每個人都能體驗 Wisconsin 的真實品味。

在旧威斯康星,我们制作最好的香肠,因为我们只挑选最优质的牛肉、猪肉和火鸡。 接下来,我们使用几代香肠制造商传承的完美香料配方。 这些香料与我们的肉类相得益彰,确保它们增强天然味道,同时不会过于让它们感到压力。 我们不使用粘结剂、填充剂或延长剂 - 只需要非常小心,以确保我们的香肠始终美味可口。本品不能代替药物。 在烟熏过程开始之前,我们手工将肉制作成各种形状和尺寸。 在传统的坑式烟房中,我们在真正的硬木火上慢慢吸烟所有肉类,以确保天然味道。 我们把它们悬挂起来,只要它就能保持,直到我们对味道感到满意为止。 在熏制肉后,我们会立即打包,以密封新鲜和风味。 过程的每一步都采取了质量控制程序,并且在最佳温度下储存,以保持新鲜度和质量。 但我们的产品很少会出现。 我们发货给全国各地的零售商,让每个人都体验威斯康星的真正品味。

description: SMITH'S LOG SMOKEHOUSE was founded and built in the woods of Maine in 1980 by Andrew Smith, a third generation meat cutter from Philadelphia who came to Maine to lead a simpler life. Smith yarded the logs for his buildings with oxen he raised and trained, using them as well to haul his smoke wood from the forest. This slow, deliberate pace was to be the hallmark of his smoking operation. A family run business, watching over the meat as it cures or the cheese at it slow-smokes over smoldering pecan shells is like watching over one of their own--each batch of hams is tended at birth through maturity, hung in the smokehouse and aged by the loving hands of the family. Smith's motto: "The quality of the latest finished product cannot be superseded by the happiness of the moment.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

description:
At Old Wisconsin, we craft the finest sausages because we pick only the most premium cuts of beef, pork and turkey. Next we use the perfect recipe of spices passed down by generations of sausage makers. These spices complement our meats, ensuring that they enhance the natural flavors while never overpowering them. We use no binders, fillers or extenders—just enormous care to ensure that our sausages are always mouthwateringly delicious. We hand craft our meats into a variety of shapes and sizes before we begin the smoking process. We smoke all of our meats slowly over real hardwood fires in our traditional pit style smokehouse to ensure natural flavor. We leave them hanging for as long as it takes until we're satisfied with the flavor. After we smoke our meats, we pack them immediately to seal in the freshness and flavor. Quality control procedures are in place at every step of the process, and goods are stored under optimal temperatures to maintain freshness and quality. But our products rarely sit around. We ship to retailers all across the country, allowing everyone to experience the true taste of Wisconsin.

Bei Old Wisconsin fertigen wir die feinsten Würstchen an, weil wir nur die hochwertigsten Stücke von Rind, Schweinefleisch und Truthahn wählen. Als nächstes verwenden wir das perfekte Rezept von Gewürzen, die von Generationen von Wurstherstellern weitergegeben wurden. Diese Gewürze ergänzen unser Fleisch, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die natürlichen Aromen verbessern und sie niemals überwältigen. Wir verwenden keine Bindemittel, Füllstoffe oder Extender – nur enorme Sorgfalt, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Würstchen immer köstlich sind. Wir fertigen unser Fleisch in eine Vielzahl von Formen und Größen, bevor wir mit dem Räuchern beginnen. Wir räuchern alle unsere Fleischsorten langsam über echtem Hartholzfeuer in unserem traditionellen Räucherofen im Gruben-Stil, um einen natürlichen Geschmack zu gewährleisten. Wir lassen sie so lange hängen, wie es dauert, bis wir mit dem Geschmack zufrieden sind. Nachdem wir unser Fleisch geraucht haben, verpacken wir sie sofort, um die Frische und den Geschmack einzuschließen. Qualitätskontrollverfahren werden bei jedem Schritt des Prozesses eingesetzt, und die Waren werden unter optimalen Temperaturen gelagert, um Frische und Qualität zu erhalten. Aber unsere Produkte sitzen selten herum. Wir versenden Einzelhändler im ganzen Land, so dass jeder den wahren Geschmack von Wisconsin erleben kann.

Na Old Wisconsin, fabricamos as melhores linguiças porque escolhemos apenas os cortes de carne bovina, porco e peru. Em seguida, usamos a receita perfeita de especiarias passadas por gerações de fabricantes de linguiças. Estas especiarias complementam nossas carnes, garantindo que elas realçam os sabores naturais enquanto nunca os dominam. Não usamos pastas, enchimentos ou extensores — apenas um cuidado enorme para garantir que nossas linguiças estejam sempre deliciosas. Fabricamos nossas carnes à mão em uma variedade de formas e tamanhos antes de começarmos o processo de fumar. Fumamos todas as nossas carnes lentamente sobre incêndios de madeira reais em nossa casa de fumê tradicional para garantir o sabor natural. Deixamos eles pendurados o tempo que for necessário até estarmos satisfeitos com o sabor. Depois que fumamos nossas carnes, as embalamos imediatamente para selar o frescor e o sabor. Procedimentos de controle de qualidade estão em vigor em cada etapa do processo, e os produtos são armazenados sob temperaturas ideais para manter o frescor e a qualidade. Mas nossos produtos raramente ficam por aí. Enviamos para varejistas em todo o país, permitindo que todos experimentem o verdadeiro gosto de Wisconsin.

在旧威斯康星,我们制作最好的香肠,因为我们只挑选最优质的牛肉、猪肉和火鸡。 接下来,我们使用几代香肠制造商传承的完美香料配方。 这些香料与我们的肉类相得益彰,确保它们增强天然味道,同时不会过于让它们感到压力。 我们不使用粘结剂、填充剂或延长剂 - 只需要非常小心,以确保我们的香肠始终美味可口。本品不能代替药物。 在烟熏过程开始之前,我们手工将肉制作成各种形状和尺寸。 在传统的坑式烟房中,我们在真正的硬木火上慢慢吸烟所有肉类,以确保天然味道。 我们把它们悬挂起来,只要它就能保持,直到我们对味道感到满意为止。 在熏制肉后,我们会立即打包,以密封新鲜和风味。 过程的每一步都采取了质量控制程序,并且在最佳温度下储存,以保持新鲜度和质量。 但我们的产品很少会出现。 我们发货给全国各地的零售商,让每个人都体验威斯康星的真正品味。

description:
Fish Maw is sun-dried swim bladder of fish which is an internal gas-filled organ found in most fish. It is commonly used in Chinese cooking and in Chinese soups. Fish Maw is an excellent source of collagen.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

RECIPE

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup
Ingredients: 3 sea cucumbers, 80g fish maw, 300g pork shin
1. Rinse all the ingredients thoroughly and blanch pork shin.
2. Combine all ingredients with 2500ml of water in a pot. Place over high heat until the water boils and then switch to low heat to simmer for additional 2 hours. Add salt to taste.

Storage Condition

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description: Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

description: What is biltong, and why is it better than beef jerky? Originating in South Africa, this tasty meat snack has slowly been making its way across the world. Have one bite, and it's easy to see why, it's hard to explain what makes it so good, but we'll try. Made from high-quality beef that's cut into thick strips, it's dipped in vinegar, coated in a mix of all-natural spices, and then left to cure in a controlled air dried environment. We make it by hand in small batches. The result is a hella flavorful, tender, chewy, and instantly addicting meat strips and bits, that also happens to be extremely healthy, protein-packed, and convenient for eating at home or on the go. There's no mountains of sugar and gallons of marinade here, and it's not made out of mystery meat like most jerky on the market. Who are we? Our story is a simple one, two guys traveled to South Africa, ate biltong, fell in love with its meaty goodness. Returned home to the US and couldn't find it anywhere. Understandably, we panicked and fell into a deep depression. It got so bad, we decided to make it ourselves. Many months of experimenting, tweaking, consulting, and burning the midnight oil later, we arrived at a product that we couldn't be more proud of. Truth be told, as born and bred Americans, we have no business making biltong. In fact, we're pretty sure it violates some sort of international law. Yet, here we are. Up to our elbows in this delicate, flavorful, and incredibly delicious South African specialty. Try it today, it's freakin good.

description: Description for Rajnigandha, Polianthes Tuberosa Polianthes tuberosa, the tuberose, is a perennial plant related to the agaves, extracts of which are used as a note in perfumery. The common name derives from the Latin tuberosa, meaning swollen or tuberous in reference to it's root system. Polianthes Tuberosa (Rajnigandha), the tuberose is a perennial flowering plant (A perennial plant is a plant that lives for more than two years). Meaning of Rajanigandha is The Fragrance of the Night, it has tubular blooms with magical and seductive fragrance which is uncommon and spells magic to all who smell it. It grows in elongated spikes up to 45 cm (18 in) long that produce clusters of fragrant waxy white flowers that bloom from the bottom towards the top of the spike. It has long, bright green leaves clustered at the base of the plant and smaller, clasping leaves along the stem.

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

ABOUT NAKED COW BEEF JERKY

Our jerky is made from grass fed cows and real spices, none of that "udder" stuff. We make real jerky for real hungry people. Whether you need protein to get through your next set of burpees or the fuel to hike a few more miles, look to Naked Cow for the meat you seek!

OUR FLAVORS

SMOKE - The most basic of our flavors blends the taste of high quality grass fed beef and the smoke that made it jerky. While the process is relatively simple, the resulting flavor is highly complex and very tasty.

FIRE - We take our basic recipe and add in some cayenne, habanero, and even a little ghost chili peppers to make a bold, spicy taste. This blend of our grass fed beef jerky really brings the heat.

HONEY - Our smoked grass fed beef jerky cooked with a fresh coating of honey that sweetens the flavor and compliments the natural spice of the jerky.

BENEFITS OF GRASS FED BEEF JERKY

- Leaner beef for a better texture and quality jerky
- 2-5 times more in omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin B6 and beta-carotene
- Higher levels of conjugated lenoleic acid (CLA), a potent antioxidant
- Higher in "good" unsaturated fats and lower in "bad" saturated fats
- Lower cholesterol

OUR SATISFACTION GUARANTEE

If for any reason you do not like our Naked Cow Beef Jerky, simply contact us for a full, no questions asked refund. We are so confident that you will fall in love with our jerky that we have decided to take all the risk. Go ahead and give us a try, we promise you won't regret it!

فكر في طريقك. كما لو كانت قبل ذلك. تدعم الحضارات القديمة نفسها باللحم. كيف سيبنون أهرامات أو يفوزون بمعارك السيف؟ لحم. إذا كانت تعمل من أجلهم، فإنها بالتأكيد ستساعدك على الطاقة من خلالها. ربما لن تبني أهرامات ولكن لا نهاية لها للقيام بها، وأنشطة الأطفال والفصول الدراسية، واللعب اليومي للعمل، والضغط في التمرين وأكثر من ذلك بكثير يمكن أن تشعر بها تمامًا. بغض النظر عن ما تتناوله، فإن وعاء اللحم البقري الخاص بنا هو الخيار المثالي للوجبات الخفيفة لخلاله.

يعتبر لحم تيرياكي بيف جيركي من جاك لينك أفضل ما يمكن أن يلتقي مع الوجبات الخفيفة الغربية في الشرق! مليئة بالنكهة، نبدأ بقطع قليلة من لحم البقر الفاخر بنسبة 100% ومكونات بسيطة مثل الماء والملح. نضيف الصويا والزنجبيل والقليل من البصل. بعد ذلك، نطهي ببطء على الدخان الصلب للحصول على نكهة تياكي المميزة التي هي المفضلة لدى محبي الأشرار من جميع الأعمار. إن لحم تيراكي من جاك لينك غني بـ 10 غرام من البروتين و80 سعرة حرارية فقط ولا يحتوي على مركب ميثيل سلفونيل الميثان (MSG). إنه وجبة خفيفة رائعة للمساعدة في إرضاء جوعك وتغذية أكثر الأيام انشغالاً.

صنع اللحم البقري اللذيذ من شرائح قليلة من لحم البقر الفاخر بنسبة 100%، ثم تم تبينه بمكونات بسيطة مثل الملح والماء. خالي من الدهون بنسبة 96% دون إضافة ميثيل سلفونيل الميثان (MSG)، ودائمًا ما يكون من الخشب الصلب المدخن والطهو ببطء، مما يؤدي إلى وجبة خفيفة لذيذة وخفيفة.

كل كيس من الأكياس سعة 266 مل يمكن إعادة غلقه، لذا سيكون طعامك والوجبات الخفيفة المفضل طازجًا دائمًا بمجرد أول مرة تفتح فيها الحقيبة! أحضر واحدة للعمل من أجل توفير الطاقة خلال استراحة الوجبات الخفيفة الثانية مساءً واحتفظ بواحدة في المنزل في المخزن من أجل القيام بمهام السبت الصباحية.

جاك لينك هي العلامة التجارية الأكثر مبيعاً لفرعة اللحم البقري، ونحن فخورون بأن نكون شركة مملوكة لعائلة! عندما تفتح حقيبة من منتجات جاك لينك، سوف تحصل على ذوق التقليد الأمريكي الذي جعل هذه الأعمال العائلية ناجحة: العمل الشاق والمرح والمنتجات عالية الجودة. الوجبات الخفيفة البروتينية من جاك لينك هي وقود للأشخاص لتغذية جانبهم البري، بغض النظر عن المناسبة.

From our Ranch in Montana to your home!]
description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description:
GRASS-FED HORMONE-FREE CURED BEEF. 

Easy snacking, tasty, and filling, Biltong is the tender meat snack you have been looking for.  Especially made for athletes with an insatiable appetite, these thin cuts of meat simply melt in your mouth.  

People have been curing meat for thousands of years, but in South Africa during the early days of settlement, curing meat took on a whole new flavor profile. The basic spicing of Biltong is a dramatic blend of vinegar, salt, sugar, coriander and other spices. These were in abundance in the Cape Colony at the time, as the French Huguenots produced wine and vinegar from their grape crops to support seafarers from Europe, who made the Cape of Good Hope (modern-day Cape Town) their halfway stop on the spice route to the Far East. The Seafarers would have arrived in Cape Town with beef that was almost inedible – the only meat they had left was the thickest part of the animal, the “biltong”, or hindquarter strip – which had been in salt barrels for months. To rehydrate the beef, the settlers had to soak the beef in vinegar, and then cured it in the African sun after coating it is coriander and pepper.  The result: A delicious spicy meat that can be stored for months, and is always tender.
Lion’s Head Foods is proud to distribute grass-fed hormone-free USDA certified beef with curing practices that stay true to the original methods. This delicious cured meat tastes just as good as the original safari snack found in the Cape. 

We hope you enjoy it as much as we do! 

Lion’s Head Foods takes its name from the mountain by the same name in Cape Town - which overlooked the settlers who developed the fabulous flavor profiles that you will find in Biltong!

description:
Louisville Vegan Jerky Company was started in my home kitchen back in 2012. Having spent some time in Oahu as a child, I was craving manapua. Using my mom's old recipe, I substituted baked soy for the pork and popped my seasoned protein in the oven. I was busy preparing the dough and chatting with friends when the smell of chargrilled meat hit my nose. "Toe-y!" I screamed at my three-legged dog, Tofu "I forgot to set a timer!" The barbequed soy protein was overdone, super chewy, and absolutely delicious. Tofu agreed. I headed straight to the local bar where I passed around bags of my newly discovered jerky to a full patio of hip Louisville beer drinkers. Within minutes, everyone was as excited as I was. They devoured the fortuitous first batch and asked for more. Where could they buy it? What was it called? And the best part...none of them even knew it was vegan. Today, Louisville Vegan Jerky is sold in stores all over America, but we still make each bag the same old way- in small batches, by hand, and with freshly sourced Kentucky ingredients. It's a difference you can taste, and a cruelty-free, American-made product that we're proud to call our own. One bite and you'll agree, fake has never tasted so real. So grab something to drink and join us, there's plenty to go around.

Louisville Vegan Jerky Company wurde 2012 in meiner Küche gegründet. Nachdem ich einige Zeit in Oahu als Kind verbracht hatte, war ich nach Manapua. Mit dem alten Rezept meiner Mutter habe ich gebackenes Soja gegen das Schweinefleisch ersetzt und mein gewürztes Protein im Ofen gegeben. Ich war damit beschäftigt, den Teig zuzubereiten und mit Freunden zu plaudern, als der Geruch von Holzkohlegrillfleisch meine Nase trifft. "Toe-y!" Ich schrei meinen dreibeinigen Hund, Tofu "habe ich vergessen, einen Timer einzustellen!" Das gegrillte Soja-Protein war übergemacht, super kauig und absolut lecker. Tofu stimmte zu. Ich ging direkt in die lokale Bar, wo ich Taschen meines neu entdeckten Jerky auf eine volle Terrasse von hippen Louisville Biertrinkern vorbeigehen. Innerhalb weniger Minuten war jeder so aufgeregt wie ich. Sie verschlingen die glückliche erste Charge und fragten nach mehr. Wo könnten sie es kaufen? Wie wurde es genannt? Und das Beste: keiner von ihnen wusste überhaupt, dass es vegan ist. Heute wird Louisville Vegan Jerky in Geschäften in ganz Amerika verkauft, aber wir produzieren immer noch jede Tasche auf die gleiche alte Art - in kleinen Chargen, von Hand und mit frisch gewonnenen Kentucky-Zutaten. Es ist ein Unterschied, den Sie schmecken können, und ein tierversuchsfreies, amerikanisches Produkt, das wir stolz sind, unser eigenes nennen zu können. Ein Biss und Sie werden zustimmen, gefälschte hat noch nie so echt schmeckt. Also schnappen Sie sich etwas, um zu trinken und schließen Sie uns an, es gibt viel zu gehen.

חברת Louisville Vegan Jerky נוסדה במטבח הביתי שלי בשנת 2012. לאחר שביליתי קצת זמן באוהו כילד, השתוקקתי למנפואה. באמצעות המתכון הישן של אמא שלי, החלפתי סויה אפויה לבשר חזיר והוצאתי את החלבון המנוסה שלי בתנור. הייתי עסוק בהכנת הבצק ולשוחח עם חברים כאשר ריח הבשר שארג מכה באף. "Toe-y!" צרחתי על הכלב בעל שלוש הרגליים שלי, טופו "שכחתי להגדיר טיימר!" חלבון הסויה עם הברביקיו היה מוגזם, ללעוס במיוחד, וטעים לחלוטין. טופו הסכים. עברתי ישר לבר המקומי שם עברתי סביב שקיות של הג'רקי החדש שלי שהתגלה לפטיו מלא של שותי הבירה היפ לואיוויל. בתוך דקות, כולם היו נרגשים כמוני. הם טרפו את המנה הראשונה המזורקת וביקשו עוד. איפה הם יכולים לקנות את זה? איך הוא נקרא? והכי טוב... אף אחד מהם אפילו לא ידע שזה טבעוני. היום, Louisville Vegan Jerky נמכר בחנויות בכל רחבי אמריקה, אבל אנחנו עדיין מייצרים כל תיק באותו אופן - במצבורים קטנים, בעבודת יד, ועם מרכיבים טריים מקנטאקי. זה הבדל שאתם יכולים לטעום, ומוצר נטול אכזריות, תוצרת ארה"ב שאנו גאים לקרוא משלנו. נשיכה אחת ותסכימו, זיוף מעולם לא היה כל כך אמיתי. אז קח משהו לשתות והצטרף אלינו, יש מספיק מה להתמודד.

بدأت شركة لويسفيل فيغان جيركي في مطبخ منزلي عام 2012. بعد أن قضيت بعض الوقت في أوهو كطفل، كنت أتوق إلى مانابوا. باستخدام وصفة أمي القديمة، استبدلت الصويا المخبوزة للحرير وأفرغ البروتين المتخمر في الفرن. كنت مشغولًا بإعداد العجين والدردشة مع الأصدقاء عندما اصطدمت رائحة اللحم المشحون أنفي. "Toe-y!" لقد صرخ كلبي ثلاثي الأرجل، توفو "نسينت ضبط مؤقتات!" تم إنهاء بروتين الصويا المشوي بشكل مفرط، فائق المضغ واللذيذ للغاية. وافقت توفو. لقد توجهت مباشرة إلى الحانة المحلية حيث مررت في حقائب من جركي التي اكتشفت حديثًا إلى فناء كامل من شاربي الجعة في هيب لويس فيل. في غضون دقائق، كان الجميع متحمسًا كما كنت. لقد ألهموا المجموعة الأولى الهائلة وطلبوا المزيد. أين يمكنهم شراؤه؟ ماذا كان اسمه؟ والأفضل من ذلك...لم يكن أحد منهم يعلم أنه نباتي بالكامل. واليوم، تُباع منتجات لويسفيل فيغان جيركي في المتاجر في جميع أنحاء أمريكا، ولكننا ما زلنا نصنع كل حقيبة بنفس الطريقة القديمة - في مجموعات صغيرة، باليد، ومع مكونات كنتاكي التي تم الحصول عليها حديثًا. إنه فرق يمكنك تذوقه، وهو منتج أمريكي مصنوع بدون إساءة تجاه الحيوانات، ونحن نفخر بأنه خاص بنا. قضمة واحدة وسوف توافق على أن المنتجات المزيفة لم تذوقها أبدًا حقيقي. لذا احصل على شيء للشرب وانضم إلينا، هناك الكثير من الأشياء التي تذهب.

Louisville Vegan Jerky Company foi fundada na minha cozinha de casa em 2012. Tendo passado algum tempo em Oahu quando criança, eu estava desejando manapua. Usando a receita antiga da minha mãe, substitui a soja assada pelo porco e peguei minha proteína temperada no forno. Eu estava ocupado preparando a massa e conversando com amigos quando o cheiro de carne encorpada acertou no meu nariz. "Toe-y!" Eu gritou para meu cão de três patas, Tofu "Esqueci de definir um temporizador." A proteína de soja foi superfeita, super mastigável e absolutamente deliciosa. Tofu concordou. Eu fui direto para o bar local onde eu passei por bolsas do meu recém-descoberto carne seca para um pátio completo de bebedores de cerveja Louisville. Em poucos minutos, todos ficaram tão animados quanto eu. Eles devoraram o fortuito primeiro lote e pediram mais. Onde eles poderiam comprar? Como foi chamado? Então pegue algo para beber e junte-se a nós, há muito para se divertir.

Louisville Vegan Jerky Company는 2012년 홈 키친에서 시작되었습니다. 오아후에서 어렸을 때 저는 마나푸아를 갈망했습니다. 엄마의 오래된 레시피를 사용하여 구운 콩을 돼지 고기로 대체하고 오븐에서 노련한 단백질을 터뜨렸습니다. 나는 으깬 고기 냄새가 코에 닿았을 때 반죽을 준비하고 친구들과 채팅을 하는 바쁩니다. "Toe-y!" 저는 세 발 모양의 개를 비명을 지르고, 두부 "타이머를 설정하는 것을 잊었습니다!" 바베큐 콩 단백질은 과장되어 매우 질기며 절대적으로 맛있었습니다. 두부는 동의했습니다. 저는 곧바로 현지 바에 가서 새로 발견된 육포의 가방을 돌아다니며 루이빌 맥주 마시는 사람들들로 가득한 파티오로 나갔습니다. 몇 분 안에 모든 사람이 제처럼 흥분했습니다. 그들은 행운의 첫 번째 배치를 삼키고 더 많은 것을 요구했습니다. 어디서 살 수 있을까요? 무엇이라고 불리나요? 그리고 가장 좋은 부분은...그들 중 누구도 그것이 비건 제품이라는 것을 알지 못했습니다. 오늘날 Louisville Vegan Jerky는 미국 전역의 매장에서 판매되지만, 저희는 여전히 각 가방을 소량으로 손으로 직접 만들며 갓 공급한 켄터키 재료로 만듭니다. 이것은 당신이 맛볼 수 있는 차이이며, 동물 실험을 하지 않은 미국 제 제품으로 우리가 우리 제품이라고 부르는 것을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다. 한 번 물면 동의할 것입니다. 가짜는 이렇게 진짜 맛이 없었습니다. 그러니 마시고 우리와 함께할 무언가를 챙겨 다니세요.

description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.

description:
Original Recipe:

This is the recipe that started it all. We begin with a simple blend of classic spices before adding chopped green Italian parsley and a touch of real roasted garlic to give these Smoked Shorty Sausages their authentic old world flavor.

Hot & Spicy:

Diced red and green Serranos are the perfect peppers for our Hot & Spicy Smoked Shorty Sausages because their natural oils add a flavorful heat that reminds us of freshly-made salsa – a flavor you can’t get with just dried pepper powder.

Hatch Green Chile:

It’s no wonder why Hatch chiles have become famous through the decades. The valley’s cooler climate helps our local farmer friends produce chiles with a unforgettably-smoky and sweet taste. We roast them, dice them thick, and let the natural chile oils infuse the sausages with their signature Hatch flavor.

Chorizo and Lime:

Duke's chorizo and lime pork smoked sausages are hand-hung and slow-dried for days in small batches. Avocado and hickory smoke perfectly balances the tanginess of the lime. Sure to please!

Think Before You Eat!

Founder Ricky Hirsch was shocked to discover that most jerky products are pumped full sugar and pesticides that kill your immunity, so he set out to create a jerky that is both healthy and delicious. By partnering with some of the world’s best Chefs, consciously minimizing sugar and salt, and only using the healthiest ingredients, Ricky takes jerky from gas station food to health food.

הג'רקי המתוק הטעים שלנו מיוצר על ידי מומחה לחווה לשולחן ושף אלוף BaconFest Champion, Matt Troost. מבושל לאט עד לשלמות, קווצות הבשר שלנו רכות ומועשירות במרכיבים טעימים עוד יותר כדי לתת לך זינג מעורר תיאבון. חוו ניקוב אחד של שניים של טעמים למתכון שלו, תחילה עם המתיקות של פטל אמיתי, ואז עם תערובת שלושה פלפלים לגימור חריף.

description:
Fish Maw is sun-dried swim bladder of fish which is an internal gas-filled organ found in most fish. It is commonly used in Chinese cooking and in Chinese soups. Fish Maw is an excellent source of collagen.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

RECIPE

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup
Ingredients: 3 sea cucumbers, 80g fish maw, 300g pork shin
1. Rinse all the ingredients thoroughly and blanch pork shin.
2. Combine all ingredients with 2500ml of water in a pot. Place over high heat until the water boils and then switch to low heat to simmer for additional 2 hours. Add salt to taste.

Storage Condition

You are strongly recommended to store the items in a clean, ventilating and dry place.

description: Rousong also known as meat wool, meat floss, pork floss, flossy pork, abon, pork sung or yuk sung, is a dried meat product with a light and fluffy texture similar to coarse cotton, originating from China. Rousong is used as a topping for many foods, such as congee, tofu, and savoury soy milk. It is also used as filling for various buns and pastries, and as a snack food on its own. Rousong is a very popular food item in Chinese cuisine. Rousong is made by stewing cuts of pork in a sweetened soy sauce mixture until individual muscle fibres can be easily torn apart with a fork. This happens when the water-insoluble collagen that holds the muscle fibres of the meat together has been converted into water-soluble gelatine. The meat is teased apart, strained, and partially dried in the oven. It is then mashed and beaten while being dry-cooked in a large wok until it is nearly completely dry. Additional flavourings are usually added while the mixture is being dry-fried. Five kilograms of meat will usually yield about one kilogram of floss. Certificate : GMP, HACCP

description: What is biltong, and why is it better than beef jerky? Originating in South Africa, this tasty meat snack has slowly been making its way across the world. Have one bite, and it's easy to see why, it's hard to explain what makes it so good, but we'll try. Made from high-quality beef that's cut into thick strips, it's dipped in vinegar, coated in a mix of all-natural spices, and then left to cure in a controlled air dried environment. We make it by hand in small batches. The result is a hella flavorful, tender, chewy, and instantly addicting meat strips and bits, that also happens to be extremely healthy, protein-packed, and convenient for eating at home or on the go. There's no mountains of sugar and gallons of marinade here, and it's not made out of mystery meat like most jerky on the market. Who are we? Our story is a simple one, two guys traveled to South Africa, ate biltong, fell in love with its meaty goodness. Returned home to the US and couldn't find it anywhere. Understandably, we panicked and fell into a deep depression. It got so bad, we decided to make it ourselves. Many months of experimenting, tweaking, consulting, and burning the midnight oil later, we arrived at a product that we couldn't be more proud of. Truth be told, as born and bred Americans, we have no business making biltong. In fact, we're pretty sure it violates some sort of international law. Yet, here we are. Up to our elbows in this delicate, flavorful, and incredibly delicious South African specialty. Try it today, it's freakin good.

description:
ABOUT NAKED COW BEEF JERKY

Our jerky is made from grass fed cows and real spices, none of that "udder" stuff. We make real jerky for real hungry people. Whether you need protein to get through your next set of burpees or the fuel to hike a few more miles, look to Naked Cow for the meat you seek!

OUR FLAVORS

SMOKE - The most basic of our flavors blends the taste of high quality grass fed beef and the smoke that made it jerky. While the process is relatively simple, the resulting flavor is highly complex and very tasty.

FIRE - We take our basic recipe and add in some cayenne, habanero, and even a little ghost chili peppers to make a bold, spicy taste. This blend of our grass fed beef jerky really brings the heat.

HONEY - Our smoked grass fed beef jerky cooked with a fresh coating of honey that sweetens the flavor and compliments the natural spice of the jerky.

BENEFITS OF GRASS FED BEEF JERKY

- Leaner beef for a better texture and quality jerky
- 2-5 times more in omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin B6 and beta-carotene
- Higher levels of conjugated lenoleic acid (CLA), a potent antioxidant
- Higher in "good" unsaturated fats and lower in "bad" saturated fats
- Lower cholesterol

OUR SATISFACTION GUARANTEE

If for any reason you do not like our Naked Cow Beef Jerky, simply contact us for a full, no questions asked refund. We are so confident that you will fall in love with our jerky that we have decided to take all the risk. Go ahead and give us a try, we promise you won't regret it!

From our Ranch in Montana to your home!]
description: At Roam Free Ranch, our bison eat grass their whole lives just outside our doorstep. We create an environment that mimics their native habitat and ancient grazing patterns. We call this method regenerative agriculture. This not only creates a healthier meat product but preserves native grasslands, the #1 most endangered ecosystem in North America. In the same way that bison used to be moved by wolves across the prairies, we rotate bison through fresh grass pastures over short periods. This also keeps the animals happier according to their native biological need to roam. Raising bison this way produces the most nutrient-dense protein on the planet - higher in iron, b12 and Omega 3s. OUR PURPOSE A keystone species of the American Prairie, bison are essential in protecting our ecosystem. We're on a mission to restore bison to their home in Montana, regenerate our native grasslands and offer bison products that retain their natural health properties - grass-fed and sugar free. But we're a small start-up and we can't do it without you. 98% of bison are owned by ranchers and without them, bison would go extinct. By buying Bison Bites, you're helping to create a sustainable market and it allows us to invest in growing our herd. For every bison we consume we can raise two more. OUR INSPIRATION Our ranch sits within the Flathead Reservation where one of five originating bison herds use to roam freely. An iconic bison rancher, Pablo Allard used this land to save bison from near extinction in the late 1800s. Once the land was opened for homesteading, Pablo sold his herd to Canada after being turned away by the US government. Removing bison from its native prairie has harmed much of this ecosystem. Roam Free is returning bison to the land where it all began, regenerating native grasses and preserving bison for future generations.
